tooling.message:
fix: archetype rules are hints; the test cleanup gets two minutes

## Intent

topic-has-exercises, start-page-explains and quiz-feedback-explains judge how well an app teaches. An app that misses them still runs and harms nobody, so a finding should not fail the review. Pushes also failed: removing a test clone's node_modules took longer than the 10 s hook timeout when several test runs shared the machine.

## Key changes

- The three archetype rules have severity hint. The building agent still aims for them and the reviewer still reports them, but they no longer fail a verdict.
- The hook that removes the temporary test folders may take two minutes.
